{{Quote|My name is Cathan Dru. It's my job to... pass along information that might benefit the Empire.|Cathan Dru|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Cathan Dru''' was a male [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] working for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Sith Empire. He hired mercenary [[Arak Malkan]] and his men to break into the [[Steelfast Data Haven|vault]] guarded by [[Revaak|Revaak's]] [[Revaak's mercenaries|mercenaries]], but after they returned empty-handed, was forced to turn to a passing Imperial for help.<ref name="TOR" />
